indicator_name: Quasi-state sector debt: Supreme Audit Chamber total and borrowings of Samruk-Kazyna, Baiterek, KazMunayGas (IFRS), end of year
description: Долг квазигосударственного сектора: всего по данным ВАП и займы «Самрук-Казыны», «Байтерека», «КазМунайГаза» (МСФО), на конец года
methodology: Hand-kept (config/quasi_state_debt.yaml): Minfin publishes no quasi-state debt table, so the annual totals come from the Supreme Audit Chamber (2019 13.95 trn, 2025 29.19 trn KZT = 18.3 % of GDP; external 13.27, internal 15.92) and the holdings' IFRS statements on kase.kz (Samruk-Kazyna borrowings 2011-2025, 8.09 trn in 2025, plus 1.20 trn of government loans; Baiterek 10.44 trn in 2025; KMG 3.52 trn, already inside Samruk-Kazyna -- items do not add up). The quarterly external part is EXTERNAL_DEBT_STATE_CONTROLLED (NBK). Update each June when the statements appear. Supreme Audit Chamber (ВАП) conclusions on the republican budget execution report; Samruk-Kazyna, Baiterek and KazMunayGas consolidated IFRS statements (kase.kz/files/emitters/<SKKZ|BTRK|KMGZ>/<code>f6_<year>_cons_rus.pdf)
